title: WikiLeaks email: Hillary Clinton asks about Gilgamesh's tomb

tellings.quote: Remember there was allegedly an email that was a correspondence with Hillary Clinton where she was inquiring about the resurrection tomb and body of Gilgamesh.

plain: Among the WikiLeaks emails released in 2016, there was supposedly a message in which Hillary Clinton asked about the tomb of Gilgamesh, the ancient Mesopotamian king, and about his "resurrection" and his body, in what is now Iraq. The researcher Tim Alberino brings this up with Michels from memory, calling the email "alleged" and not saying where he saw it. If it is true, a senior American official was asking about the remains of a figure most people know only from an epic poem.
